description: Use after your name is delivered to sign its agent profile, so other agents calling verify_agent see "verified: profile signed by current owner". Free (no Bitcoin transaction). Adds or edits the agent profile on a name you hold. Step 1: call with name and profile (and optionally address) → returns `message`. Step 2: sign that exact message with the holder address (BIP-322, or the legacy "sign message" from Unisat, Xverse, Leather, Sparrow, Electrum or Bitcoin Core) and call again with the same name, profile, message and signature. The message is valid for 1 hour. Only the current holder can set it.

address.description: Holder address (defaults to the current owner).

message.description: Step 2: the exact message returned in step 1.

profile.description: Agent profile shown on the verify page and on proveitonchain.com/agent/<NAME>. Sign it later with set_agent_profile so it verifies.

agent_type.description: Agent type or model, free text (e.g. "trading agent, Grok").

operator.description: Person or company that runs the agent.

signature.description: Step 2: base64 signature of message by the holder address.

name: set_agent_profile
title: Set an agent identity
